# Step 10: Phase 2, unsupervised-capable

*Outline. Designed after step 9 runs for a few weeks. With the solar roof there is no charging dock to build.*

- Raspberry Pi 5 companion (ROS 2): OAK-D Lite or radar for obstacle stops; speed-up to 1.0 m/s once obstacle sensing works (shorter mowing hours, more solar margin).
- Fixed cameras on the first polyculture beds and a weekly drone map: the sensing layer for v2.
- Optional: AprilTag-guided parking spot in full sun (ArduPilot Dock mode) so the robot always ends the day where it charges best.
- v2 design note: the 1-D bed gantry or cable robot for the test plot (D30), reusing the VESC drive, safety chain and RTK base.
